Privacy

This policy covers the 🤌 At Hand Tools website and inquiries about custom browser-extension development. Individual 🤌 At Hand Tools products have their own privacy pages.

What this site collects

🤌 At Hand Tools does not provide accounts, contact forms, or analytics on this site. If you choose to email hello@athand.tools, the information you include is used to reply to your inquiry.

Technical processing

The hosting and email providers involved in delivering the site and email may process ordinary technical and correspondence data under their own policies. Do not send credentials, sensitive personal data, or confidential material in an initial inquiry.

Your questions

For a privacy question or deletion request related to a studio inquiry, contact hello@athand.tools.
